Calyx · research only · no live changes

Can one EA or a basket turn $100 into $10,000?

This finite historical screen searches existing stop-based EAs with real broker lot increments and conservative margin admission. It does not find a universally “best possible” strategy or establish a reliable way to multiply money 100×.

High-risk research, not a live recommendation. Requested risk reaches 30% per trade. Real loss can exceed the simulated research floor or the original deposit. All hit fractions below are dependent historical starts—not future probabilities. Closed-cash replay does not measure floating drawdown or broker stopout.

Locked development selections

Configurations and risk were selected using development only, then written to SELECTION.json before evaluation. Primary selects the fastest conditional median among configurations with at least 50% development hits. If none qualifies, the saved highest-hit fallback is explicitly marked. Highest-hit and fastest-observed roles are separate diagnostics; the fastest-observed “lottery” path is not the recommended configuration.

Later evaluation — no reselection

Base costs retain original observed fills, spread, entry/exit fees and swaps. Stress adds one available snapshot spread each side, doubles negative recorded swap and doubles margin admission estimates. It is a sensitivity, not measured future execution.

Both locked primary choices had zero later-evaluation target hits. A fast development result did not translate into a completed $100-to-$10,000 attempt for either primary choice. Do not substitute the later best-looking diagnostic as a newly validated winner.

Floor means the $20 closed-cash latch (80% loss of the initial deposit), not reconstructed broker liquidation or proven maximum loss.

Rules and broker geometry

  • Sizing: Requested initial-stop risk = current CLOSED cash balance times risk%; floor to broker lot step, cap maximum volume, SKIP below minimum; never round up to minimum
  • Cash: Book actual native entry fees and each partial/final exit at its recorded time, linearly resized by admitted initial lots. Risk sizing does not use future profits or final outcome. No compounding of unclosed gains. Retain observed source-end censored entries and genuine partial exits, but omit artificial test-end liquidation; do not require future completion to admit an entry.
  • Success: When cash first reaches target, pause new entries, let already-owned positions exit naturally; success only if flat with cash >=10000. If cash falls below target before flat, resume entries. No artificial liquidation or mark-to-market target.
  • Failure: Latch new-entry halt at cash <=20 (80% initial-capital loss); continue existing positions to their natural closes. This is a RESEARCH failure floor, not a reconstructed broker stopout. No reset, top-up or recovery attempt.
  • Exposure: Retain full original initial-stop risk and initial margin until final exit, including partially closed positions; aggregate risk <=min(2*risk%,60%)*current cash, same-symbol risk <=risk%*current cash. Simultaneous entries ordered lexically by key then native ID, never optimized.
  • Daily pause: UTC day-start closed-cash anchor; latch no new entries for that day after closed cash loss >=min(2*risk%,30%)*day-start cash. Existing positions retain original exits. Gap/fees can exceed limits.
  • Margin: Gross sum of initial proxy margin, no hedge discount; admit only if total margin <=80% of protected cash after existing+new initial-stop reserves and new negative entry costs. Uses maximum of available current and cached per-price margin ratios (USDJPY fixed50/lot). This is conservative admission bookkeeping, NOT a historical liquidation/HMR model.
  • Stress: Extra one available quote-snapshot spread EACH SIDE times contract size, twice negative recorded swap, twice margin proxy. For an unquoted symbol use cached available quote spread. Native entries/exits unchanged; sensitivity, not measured execution.

Broker reference: Exness Technologies Ltd · Exness-MT5Trial15 · USD · snapshot leverage 1:2000. The leverage number is not applied uniformly across instruments; measured/cached contract margin proxies govern admission.

What this screen cannot establish

  • 100x capital target is extreme; high risk can lose most or all capital. No guarantee or future probability claim.
  • Closed-cash replay does not measure floating equity, broker stopout, intrabar liquidation, order latency or actual account execution. A modeled success can be untradeable in reality.
  • Immutable standalone fills do not recover counterfactual later signals after skipped entries, changed EA state or changed lot size. No native simultaneous portfolio test.
  • Historical source Trial16 and current demo Trial15 are different feeds; mixed/generated ticks, linear resizing and sampled costs do not reproduce real liquidity/slippage.
  • Full original stop reserve until final partial exit is deliberately conservative, not exact EA risk release.
  • Same-second exit ordering may use publisher 1ms epsilon for sorting, not measured latency. Close-first cross-position tie convention may not be executable.
  • No live changes, trades, installers, BAT edits or automatic push.
  • Historical signal-ledger replay is not a simultaneous native or live execution; only original standalone signals exist.
  • Current strategies and past data were previously researched. A later chronological split is a selection check, not genuinely untouched out-of-sample evidence.
  • Native tests report 15% real ticks; real ticks begin January 2026. Earlier generated/mixed tick execution may alter tight-stop results.
  • Entry sizing uses closed cash, not floating equity. No tick/intraday equity drawdown or liquidation path is available in this input model.
  • Source actual fills/spread/commission/fees/swap are retained. Resized fills assume linear execution; liquidity and broker fee tiers are not reconstructed.
  • Broker snapshot is Trial15; historical standalone test source is Trial16. Contract/lot parity is checked, quote and historical cost parity are not established.
  • Margin is a conservative current/cached snapshot estimate, not historical HMR, tiers, repricing, netting, liquidation, or a guarantee of broker acceptance.
  • ETH has no current quote/margin receipt; its cached Trial15 price-scaled margin ratio is used. BTC current margin ratio is lower than cached; larger cached ratio is retained.
  • ETH spread stress uses the latest positive-spread cached Trial15 M1 bar from September 2026; this is a stale bar-spread proxy, not a live bid/ask receipt.
  • USDJPY initial risk uses original SL-price currency conversion, consistent with the published ledger, not an exact historical fill-time OrderCalcProfit receipt.
  • Six source-end censored entries are retained with known genuine deal cashflows and initial risk; their artificial final liquidations are omitted. Closed-cash simulation must retain their remaining exposure through the boundary.
  • Source same-second exits use the publisher ordering epsilon of 1ms; this is an ordering convention, not measured millisecond precision.
  • Nasdaq overnight source has no entries before June 2023; this is shorter observed coverage, not proof of no earlier signals.
  • Four News Pulse EAs and Gold News V9 are excluded; this is not a claim that all 37 EAs were validly tested.
  • No production EA, BAT, preset, active terminal, website, or account is changed by this preparation.
